disclaimer: A passing test verifies that this implementation matches the printed equations and the printed parameter table it was built from. It does not establish scientific validity and it reproduces no figure of the paper: the paper prints no digitised trajectory, so a run evaluates the printed model at the caller's own inputs.

missing_models.label: Digitised time series
missing_models.why_not_implemented: Figures 1-9 are referenced but no coordinate set with digitisation provenance has been supplied, so there is nothing to digitise. This package therefore reproduces no figure; it evaluates the printed model.

missing_models.label: The initial-enzyme factors cS and cO
missing_models.why_not_implemented: The Appendix's initial-value equations multiply by cS and cO; no value for either is printed on any page, so both are required run inputs.

missing_models.label: An oxygen-transfer correlation for kLa
missing_models.why_not_implemented: Equation (4) takes kLa as an input; the paper prints no correlation and no value of kLa for these cultivations, so it is a required run input.

missing_models.label: Coupling to the composition layer
missing_models.why_not_implemented: This is a standalone model of Lin et al.'s own experiment. It declares no ports, transfers no parameter, adds no adapter registration and makes no compatibility claim.

printed_equations.statement: DOT. = kLa(DOT* - DOT) - qO X H
if qOs > qOcap: qOs = qOcap; qSoxen = qOcap/YO/S; qSox = (qmr CS YX/S,ox - qSoxen)/(CS YX/S,ox - 1); qSoxan = qSox - qSoxen
if qSox < qmr: qmr = qSox = qSoxen and qSoxan = 0
if qAcen > qOcap - qOs/YO/A: qAcen = qOcap - qOs/YO/A; qAc = qAcen/(1 - YX/A CA); qAcan = qAc - qAcen
mu = (qSox - qm) YX/S,ox + qSof YX/S,of + qAc YX/A

scope: The complete simulation model printed in the Appendix of Lin et al. (2001), Biotechnology and Bioengineering 73(5):347-357, together with Table I's parameter set and the paper's reported uptake capacities.

source.citation: H. Y. Lin, B. Mathiszik, B. Xu, S.-O. Enfors, P. Neubauer, 'Determination of the Maximum Specific Uptake Capacities for Glucose and Oxygen in Glucose-Limited Fed-Batch Cultivations of Escherichia coli', Biotechnology and Bioengineering 73(5):347-357, 2001.
source.page_numbering_evidence: the article is paginated 347-357 and each page carries a running footer whose leading integer is its own printed page number, so pdf_page = printed_page - 346

target_process_note: The composition layer's target process is Zielinski et al. (2019), E. coli 20 IBA 1 / pIBAINS in GMS medium, 4 L in a 7.5 L Bioflo Celligen 310 with pH-stat glucose feeding at 30 degC. Lin et al. use a different strain, a different (uninduced) plasmid, a different medium, different reactors and 35 degC. This package is standalone: it does not register a model, does not declare ports, and transfers no parameter to that process.
